project_identity.name: Orilla - Restaurant Storefront
project_identity.concept: Continuous Scroll Mediterranean Journey with Marshmallow Insurance & Headspace level creative branding
project_identity.archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY mixed with VIBRANT PLAY (Marshmallow Hot Pink + High Contrast Mediterranean Tones)

headings.style: Ultra-expressive custom wordmark and section headers, tight tracking (-0.03em), bold display character

body.style: Clean geometric readability with friendly open counters, relaxed line height (leading-relaxed)

rules.hierarchy: H1: text-5xl to text-6xl, H2: text-3xl to text-4xl, H3: text-xl to text-2xl, Body: text-base

regions_scroll_color_morph.name: Levante y Líbano - Costa del Cedro

brand_system_and_mascots.concept: Marshforms meets Headspace friendly characters. Modular SVG shapes (circles, arched pillars, stars, waves, olive drops) that combine into living cuisine mascots.

scroll_journey_and_color_morph.engine: Framer Motion useScroll + useTransform + Lenis smooth scroll
scroll_journey_and_color_morph.implementation: Wrap the main viewport in a fixed background container that smoothly morphs its background color based on section scroll offset. As the user scrolls into a region section, the mascot animates with bounce/float micro-interactions.
scroll_journey_and_color_morph.floating_nav: Sticky header with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-md bg-black/30 or bg-white/30 depending on contrast), showing regional quick-jump anchors.

layouts_and_grids.hero: Asymmetric Bento Grid with massive Bricolage Grotesque logo, floating 3D/SVG mascot, video/interactive scroll prompt, and signature dish badge.
layouts_and_grids.regional_sections: Alternating 2-column bento card system. Left: Regional mascot + story + signature ingredients. Right: Dish grid (3-4 dishes per region with prices, tags like 'Vegano', 'Estrella', 'Sin Gluten').
layouts_and_grids.manifesto: Large editorial typographic block with high contrast, modular Marshform illustrations and brand quotes.
layouts_and_grids.location_and_reservations: Tactical card layout with working hours badge, interactive WhatsApp reservation button, live address, and map visual card.

components_and_sections: HeaderNav: Sticky Glassmorphism Header with logo and regional quick jump pill badges
HeroSection: Bold Marshmallow-style introduction with continuous scroll trigger indicator
MascotSVGComponent: Dynamic SVG mascot renderer with Framer Motion hover & scroll keyframe animations
RegionalScrollWorld: Continuous scroll section wrapper with background color transition and regional header
DishCard: High-impact food card with photo, regional badge, price, ingredients list, and dish story
BrandManifestoSection: Editorial brand story explaining the philosophy of 'Orilla' and mixing cultures
InteractiveMenuFilter: Quick filter bar to filter dishes by dietary preference (Vegetariano, Mar, Carnes, Tradición)
ReservationLocationSection: Location, opening hours, phone / WhatsApp direct booking CTA card
Footer: Continuous scroll summary, newsletter badge, social icons, and credit

motion_and_interactions.mascot_animations: Idle floating (y: [-5, 5, -5], duration 3s), eye blinking, interactive click/hover wiggle
motion_and_interactions.card_transitions: Staggered fade-up entry as sections cross the scroll threshold
motion_and_interactions.button_interactions: Pill shaped buttons with active spring scale (whileTap={{ scale: 0.96 }})

accessibility.apca_contrast: All text over regional backgrounds must pass 4.5:1 contrast (white text on dark morphs, charcoal text on light morphs)
accessibility.keyboard_nav: All anchor links and reservation buttons have focus-visible rings
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements must include data-testid attributes

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic Inter for main headings. Use Bricolage Grotesque or display serif/sans.
Do not use transparent header background without blur scrim.
Ensure contrast is vibrant and clear on background morphing.
Add data-testid to every interactive component (buttons, tabs, links, modal triggers).
Implement SVG mascots as modular code components with Framer Motion so they bounce and react to scrolling.
All copy must be in Spanish as requested by the user.
instructions_to_main_agent: Read this JSON design guideline carefully. Build the 'Orilla' Storefront Landing Page using React JS with Framer Motion scroll morphing, expressive typography (Bricolage Grotesque), custom animated SVG regional mascots, full food showcase cards, manifesto section, and reservation CTA. Ensure test attributes data-testid are present on all clickable elements.
